info.title: Silent Verify API
info.description: Use the Telesign Silent Verify API to verify an end user via mobile device data associated with their device, without any additional action by the end user.

verification.description: Contains properties to pass to the client, instructing them on how to make their request directly to the carrier.

verification_url.description: A URL for the carrier that you should pass to the client. The client will then hit this URL directly.

method.description: The HTTP method to pass to the client, for them to use when making their call to the carrier.

expected_response_code.description: An HTTP status code to pass to the client, which they should expect in a successful response after making their call to the carrier.

post_body.description: A schema to pass to the client, for them to use in the request body when they make their call directly to the carrier. If no request body is needed, this value is `null`.

query_string_params.description: Contains an object to pass to the client, which contains properties and values for each query param that the client should include in the request they make directly to the carrier. If no query parameters are needed, this value is null.

{param1_name}.description: The first query param and its value.

phone_number.description: The phone number for the user you want to verify, as digits without spaces or special characters, beginning with the country dialing code.

external_id.description: Your unique identifier for this request. The response simply echoes the value provided for this parameter.

post.description:
Use this action to initiate silent verification of a user via the Telesign Silent Verify API.

**Note:** Before using the sample code on this page, contact the [Telesign Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com). We will walk you through the necessary onboarding steps before you use the service. This product is for full-service accounts only. **Your request must come from a device with a mobile carrier connection.**

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Accepts:** `application/json`
* **Responds with:** `application/json`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)
